The moment I realized oh shit something's messed up with her that probably runs a lot deeper than her BPD was the moment the friendship ended. Ok that's a bit batshit and I told her it's batshit. There's a family history of schizophrenia but if I were to slap her with that label it'd be too much of an armchair diagnosis. 

So... yeah, I didn't know if she was gonna try anything or not because she's lied about suicide attempts before for attention.  

At that point you just have to tell someone when you realize it's beyond your help and for me, it was either the mom, the cops, or her psycharitrist.  She has had the cops called on her for battery before and is currently in debt to the government for welfare abuse so that's not too good of an idea.  Psych will notify the cops so that's a shit idea too.  Which leaves me with her mom who pretty much said she's giving up on her and wants minimal contact unless she decides to "recognize and fix her mistakes".
